shared_elements: standing human figure in low relief
justification: Both surfaces depict standing human figures in relief with heads in profile and objects held in the hands, which is about as generic a correspondence as figural art offers. Beyond that they diverge sharply: A is a horizontal processional frieze of similarly dressed men leading a naturalistically modelled camel beneath a border of repeated rosettes, while B is a single vertical panel filled edge-to-edge by one heavily ornamented figure with dense schematic regalia, no animal and no repeating border band.
